newsitem.title: USA: IMF director endorses Japan financial reform plan.
newsitem.headline: IMF director endorses Japan financial reform plan.

text.p: Michel Camdessus, managing director of the International Monetary Fund, said Thursday he endorsed Japan's financial market reform plans, which he said would promote competition among foreign and domestic financial institutions in all sectors.
"I fully endorse this plan to undertake wide-ranging reforms in Japan's financial markets," Camdessus said in a statement released in Washington.
The plan would inject new vigor into the sector, playing a key role in ensuring the dynamic growth of the Japanese economy in the years ahead, he added.
The reforms would also sustain the process of making Japan's economy more open and transparent, which would benefit Japan and the rest of the world, he said.
